selectTank: Select your tank size. Larger tanks hold more gas but are heavier.
selectGas: Choose your breathing gas. Nitrox extends NDL but has a shallower MOD.
sacExplain: SAC Rate is how fast you breathe gas at the surface. Lower is better.
modExplain: MOD is the deepest you can safely go with this gas mix before O₂ toxicity risk.
ndlExplain: NDL is how long you can stay at this depth before mandatory decompression stops are needed.
ppo2Explain: PPO₂ shows oxygen partial pressure. Must stay below 1.4 bar for safety.
bwrafExplain: BWRAF is the standard buddy check before every dive. Never skip it!
safetyStopExplain: A 3-minute pause at 5m depth allows nitrogen to safely off-gas before surfacing.
